title: LORD, GO AHEAD OF ME AND MAKE MY DAY PEACEFUL AND VICTORIOUS
text: Father, we bless your holy name today. We honor you. We celebrate you. We magnify your greatness. Lord, we acknowledge that without you we can do absolutely nothing. We recognize that every breath we take, every step we make, every victory we celebrate is purely by your grace and your mercy. Today, as we [music] come before your throne, we ask that you will meet us at the point of our deepest needs. Let your glory overshadow this place. Let [music] your presence saturate every heart that is tuned in, every spirit that is hungry, every soul that is desperate for a divine encounter. Father, I pray that as we share your word tonight, that you will anoint these lips to speak [music] mysteries, to declare divine secrets, to unveil spiritual realities that will transform destinies. Let every ear that hears be blessed. Let every heart that receives be transformed. Let every life [music] that connects be elevated. We pray in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen. There is a dimension of divine [music] intervention that the Bible calls going before us. It is a ministry of God that many believers have not fully accessed because they do not understand [music] the theology behind it. You see, the Christian life is not meant to be lived in perpetual struggle, [music] constant defeat, and endless battles where we are always reacting to what the enemy throws at us. No. God has designed [music] a system where he goes ahead of you, prepares the way, removes [music] obstacles, neutralizes threats, and orchestrates circumstances in [music] your favor before you even arrive there. Tonight, I want to speak to you about this profound spiritual reality. When you pray, "Lord, go ahead of me and make my day peaceful and victorious." You are not just saying beautiful religious words. You are activating a covenant dimension where God [music] becomes your forerunner, your advanced guard, your divine strategies who fight battles on your behalf before you even know those battles exist. [music] Let me take you to the scriptures because everything we believe must be rooted in the eternal word of God. In Exodus chapter 23:20, [music] the Bible says, "Behold, I send an angel before thee to keep thee in [music] the way and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared." Do you see that? God was telling the children of Israel, "I am not sending you into the wilderness alone. I am dispatching my angel ahead of you." That angel would go before them, scout the [music] territory, prepare the ground, and ensure that when they arrive, the victory was already [music] established in the realm of the spirit. This is not just an Old Testament promise. In Isaiah 45:2, [music] God says to Cyrus, "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron." When God goes before you, he doesn't just accompany you. He transforms the very [music] landscape of your circumstances. He takes what is crooked and makes it straight. He breaks open doors [music] that have been shut for generations. He cuts through barriers that seem impossible to penetrate. Now, here is what you must understand. This dimension of divine intervention [music] is not automatic. It is activated by prayer, by faith, by alignment [music] with God's purposes, and by living a life of consecration. You cannot be in rebellion [music] against God and expect him to go before you. You cannot be living in deliberate sin and expect divine preparation [music] of your path. The Bible makes it clear in Psalm 5:12 that thou, Lord, will bless the righteous. With favor will thou compass him as with a shield. There is a requirement of righteousness, not self-righteousness, but the righteousness that comes through faith in Jesus Christ. Let me give you a prophetic insight today. There are three dimensions of time [music] operating in the spirit realm, the past, the present, and the future. Most Christians only pray concerning their present circumstances. They wake up in the morning and say, "Lord, help me today." But spiritual warfare is won or lost [music] in the future before it manifests in the present. When you pray, "Lord, go ahead of me," you are engaging in what I call preemptive spiritual [music] warfare. You are asking God to invade your future, to rearrange circumstances that have not yet manifested, to abort plans of the enemy that are still in the planning stage. The enemy studies [music] you. He watches your patterns, your weaknesses, your vulnerabilities. He sets up ambushes along your path. But when God [music] goes before you, he sees those ambushes and dismantles them. He sees the traps and removes them. He sees the opposition gathering and scatters them before you even arrive. This is why David could say in Psalm 23, "Yea, though I walk through the valley of [music] the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for thou art with me." David wasn't saying there was no danger. He was saying that even in dangerous territory, God's presence guaranteed his protection. Today, I want you to understand that peace is not the absence of challenges. Peace is the presence of God in the midst of challenges. When the Bible talks about peace, it uses the Hebrew word shalom, which means [music] completeness, wholeness, harmony, prosperity, and rest. It is a comprehensive word that encompasses every area of your life. When you pray for a peaceful day, you are not asking for a day without assignments or responsibilities. You are asking [music] for a day where God's presence so saturate your experience that even in the midst of activity, you walk in supernatural [music] rest and victory. Let me tell you something about victory [music] in the spiritual realm. Victory is not something you achieve by your strength or your wisdom. Victory is something you inherit because of your connection [music] to the one who has already won every battle. When Jesus said on the cross, "It is finished," he was declaring total and complete victory over sin, death, hell, and the grave. Every battle you will ever face has already been won [music] in the spirit realm. Your job is not to win the battle. Your job is to enforce the victory that Jesus has already secured. Now, let me show you something profound from the life of Joshua. When the children [music] of Israel were about to enter the promised land, God said to Joshua in chapter 1:9, "Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage. [music] Be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed, for the Lord thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest." Notice the phrase, "whithersoever thou goest." This means everywhere [music] Joshua would go, God's presence would be there first. God was guaranteeing that he would be Joshua's forerunner. But then in Joshua chapter 3, we see something remarkable. When they came to the Jordan River, God told the priests to step into the water [music] while it was still flooding. That required tremendous faith. But the Bible says that as soon as the soles of their feet touched [music] the water, the river stopped flowing from upstream. Do you know what that means? God had already gone ahead of them and stopped the water at a place called Adam, which was miles away, before they even reached the river. By the time they arrived at the Jordan, the miracle had already been set in motion upstream. This is what happens when God goes before you. He begins [music] to work on your behalf at the source of your challenges, not at the point where you encounter them. He cuts off negative currents at their origin. He addresses the root causes of problems before they manifest [music] as symptoms in your life. This is why you must learn to pray strategically, not just emotionally. In the book of Nehemiah, when Nehemiah was about to rebuild the walls of Jerusalem, the Bible says he sent up a quick prayer to [music] God before answering the king. That prayer activated divine favor. God [music] went ahead of Nehemiah and touched the king's heart. God arranged for resources [music] to be provided. God orchestrated protection from enemies. All of this happened because Nehemiah [music] understood the power of inviting God to go before him. So, practically, how do you activate this dimension? First, you must begin [music] your day with prayer. Not rushed religious prayer, but intentional strategic faith-filled prayer. Before you step [music] out of your house, before you get into that car, before you walk into that office, before you have that conversation, [music] invite the presence of God to go ahead of you. Declare Psalm 91 [music] over your life. Speak Isaiah 54:17. "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper." Command every ambush to be exposed and dismantled. Second, you must live a life of consecration. You cannot expect God to fight for you if you are fighting against him [music] through your lifestyle. The Bible says in James 4:7, "Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you." Notice the order. Submission comes before resistance. Many believers are trying to resist [music] the devil without first submitting to God, and that is why they are not experiencing victory. Third, you must cultivate [music] the consciousness of God's presence. The Bible says in Hebrews 13:5, "I will never leave thee nor forsake thee." God is always with you, but are you always conscious of him? When you develop [music] what Brother Lawrence called practicing the presence of God, you begin to walk in supernatural [music] sensitivity. You begin to perceive when danger is near. You begin to discern when you should turn left instead of right. You begin to receive divine warnings and divine instructions. Let me give you a testimony. There was a time I was supposed to travel on a particular day and everything was set, but as I was praying that morning, I felt a strong check [music] in my spirit. It wasn't a voice. It was just an inner knowing that something was not right. I obeyed that check and postponed my journey by one day. Later, I discovered that there had been a major [music] incident on that route on the day I was supposed to travel. God had gone ahead of me, seen the danger, and warned me through the Holy Spirit. Today, I decree and declare over your life >> [music] >> that God is going before you. Every trap that has been set for you in the coming days, the [music] Lord is removing it right now in the name of Jesus. Every ambush that the enemy has prepared, the Lord is dismantling it by the power of his spirit. Every negative [music] conspiracy, every evil gathering, every demonic counsel that has met concerning your destiny, I command it to scatter in the mighty [music] name of Jesus. I prophesy to you that your days will be peaceful. The peace [music] of God that passes all understanding will garrison your heart and mind. You will not be [music] troubled. You will not be anxious. You will not be fearful. Even when there is chaos around you, you will walk in supernatural calm because the prince of [music] peace lives inside of you. I decree and declare that your days will be victorious. You will not labor in vain. [music] You will not run in vain. Every seed you sow will produce a harvest. Every effort [music] you make will yield results. Every step you take will lead you closer to your God-ordained destination. [music] You will not suffer loss. You will not experience defeat. You are more than a conqueror through Christ Jesus who loves you. Let me take you deeper into this revelation. When God goes before you, he doesn't just remove obstacles. He also prepares divine appointments. In the book of Genesis chapter 24, Abraham's servant was sent to find a wife for Isaac. Before he even arrived at the well, God had already prepared Rebekah. Before he even prayed his prayer, God had already arranged the circumstances. The Bible says in [music] verse 15, "And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that behold Rebekah came out." Before he finished praying, the answer was already on the way. This is the dimension I want you to [music] operate in. A dimension where before you arrive at your place of breakthrough, God has already prepared [music] the people who will help you. Before you walk into that interview, God has already touched the heart of the interviewer. Before you present that proposal, God has already created favor for you in the hearts of the decision makers. This is not manipulation. This is divine [music] orchestration. The Bible says in Proverbs 21:1, "The king's heart is in the hand of the Lord as the rivers of water. He turneth it whithersoever he will." God has the ability to turn the hearts of men toward you. He can make your [music] enemies become your helpers. He can turn your opposition into your promotion. But you must pray. You must ask him to go before you. You must invite his intervention [music] into the details of your life. In the book of Esther, we see this principle powerfully demonstrated. When [music] Esther needed to approach the king, she could have been killed because it was against the law to approach without being summoned. But the Bible says she found [music] favor in his sight and he held out the golden scepter to her. That was not luck. That was divine preparation. God had gone before Esther and prepared the king's [music] heart to receive her favorably. And then the Bible tells us that on the very [music] night before Haman's evil plan was to be executed, the king couldn't sleep. That sleeplessness [music] was orchestrated by God. God went ahead of Esther's crisis and arranged for the king to [music] discover the good deed that Mordecai had done. One sleepless night changed the entire trajectory [music] of the Jewish people's destiny. This is what happens when God goes before you. He arranges circumstances in ways that human wisdom cannot orchestrate. Now, let me teach you something about spiritual [music] warfare. There are two types of warfare, reactive warfare and proactive [music] warfare. Most Christians engage in reactive warfare. They wait until the enemy attacks, then they start praying, fasting, and binding. But mature believers engage in proactive warfare. They don't wait for the attack. They strike first. They pray before the problem manifests. They decree and declare [music] victory before the battle begins. They stand in the gap and shut doors before the enemy can even approach. This is what it means to pray, "Lord, go ahead of me." You are engaging in proactive spiritual warfare. You are taking the battle to the [music] enemy's camp instead of waiting for him to bring the battle to your doorstep. The Bible says in Matthew 11:12, "And from the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffered violence and the violent take it by force." [music] You must be spiritually aggressive. You must be spiritually militant. You must not be passive in your prayer life. When you wake up [music] in the morning, don't just pray general prayers. Pray specific prayers. Command your day. Speak to your circumstances. Prophesy to your future. The Bible says in Mark 11:23, "Whosoever shall say unto this [music] mountain, 'Be thou removed and be thou cast into the sea' and shall not doubt in his heart, >> [music] >> but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass, he shall have whatsoever he saith." Notice, Jesus said, "Whosoever [music] shall say," not whosoever shall think or whosoever shall wish. You must open your mouth and speak the word [music] of faith. Now, let me reveal something to you about angels. The Bible is clear that angels [music] are ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation. Hebrews 1:14 [music] makes this abundantly clear. You have angels assigned to you. These angels do not operate independently. They operate on the basis of the word of God >> [music] >> and your prayers. Psalm 103:20 says, "Bless the Lord, ye his angels that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice [music] of his word." Notice that last phrase. "Hearkening [music] unto the voice of his word." Angels respond to the word of God. When you speak the word of God over your life, you activate angelic assistance. When you decree and declare the promises of God, angels go to work on your behalf. When you pray, "Lord, go ahead of me," you are essentially commissioning the angels that are assigned to you to go before you and prepare the way. In the book of Daniel chapter 10, we see a fascinating account [music] of spiritual warfare. Daniel had been praying for 21 days and finally an angel appeared to him and said, "From the first day that thou didst set [music] thine heart to understand and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were [music] heard and I am come for thy words." The angel had been dispatched from [music] the first day of Daniel's prayer, but there was resistance in the heavenlies. The prince of Persia withstood the angel for 21 days until Michael the Archangel [music] came to help. What does this teach us? It teaches us that when you pray, things begin to happen in the spirit realm that you cannot [music] see with your natural eyes. Angels are dispatched. Demons are confronted. Spiritual battles are fought and eventually the breakthrough manifests in the natural realm. This is why you must [music] not give up in prayer. This is why you must persist. This is why you must continue to decree and declare even when you don't see immediate results. Let me talk to you about peace because this is crucial. Jesus said in John 14:27, "Peace I leave with you. My peace I give [music] unto you. Not as the world giveth give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid." The peace that Jesus [music] gives is not dependent on circumstances. It is not based on whether everything in your life is going well or not. It is a supernatural peace [music] that can exist in the midst of the storm. When you pray for a peaceful day, you are not asking for a day without challenges. You are asking for [music] God's peace to be your portion regardless of what you face. The Bible says in Philippians [music] 4:7, "And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus." [music] That word keep in the Greek is phroureo, which means to guard, to protect, to garrison. God's peace acts like a military [music] guard around your heart and mind, preventing anxiety, fear, and worry from taking residence. This is why you [music] must fill your mind with the word of God. The Bible says in Philippians 4:8, "Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things [music] are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report, if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things." Your thought life determines your peace level. If you meditate on fear, you will walk in fear. If you meditate on worry, [music] you will be anxious. But if you meditate on the word of God, you will walk in perfect peace. Isaiah 26:3 [music] says, "Thou will keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee because he trusted [music] in thee." Perfect peace comes from keeping your mind stayed on God. This requires discipline. It requires intentionality. It requires that you take every thought captive and make it obedient [music] to Christ as 2 Corinthians 10:5 instructs us. Now, concerning victory, I want you to understand something powerful. The Bible says in 1 Corinthians 15:57, "But thanks be to God, which giveth [music] us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ." Notice it says giveth, present tense. Victory is not something you will get in the future. It is something God gives you now. The question is not whether you will have victory. The question is whether you will walk in the victory that has already been given to you. Jesus said in [music] Luke 10:19, "Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of [music] the enemy and nothing shall by any means hurt you." This is a present [music] tense promise. You have been given authority, you have been given power, you have been given dominion. The enemy has no legal right to dominate your life. The enemy has no authority to afflict you. You are seated with Christ in heavenly [music] places far above all principalities and power and might and dominion. But you must enforce this victory. You must walk in the consciousness of who you are in Christ. You must understand your identity as a child [music] of God. You are not a victim, you are a victor. You are not defeated, you are more than a conqueror. You are not struggling to overcome, you are operating [music] from a place of having already overcome because you are in Christ and Christ has overcome the world. Let me give you a practical prayer strategy [music] for each day. Before you start your day, spend time in worship. Worship shifts the atmosphere. Worship invites [music] God's presence. Worship silences the enemy. When you worship, you are acknowledging God's sovereignty over your life and your circumstances. [music] You are declaring that he's bigger than every challenge you will face that day. After worship, [music] spend time reading and meditating on the word of God. Don't just read for information, read for transformation. Let the word of [music] God speak to your spirit. Let it renew your mind. Let it build your faith. Romans 10:17 says, "So then, faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of [music] God." Your faith level is directly connected to your exposure to God's word. Then pray specifically. Don't just pray general [music] prayers. Pray over specific aspects of your day. Pray over your family. Pray over your work. Pray over your finances. [music] Pray over your relationships. Pray over your health. Cover every area [music] of your life with the blood of Jesus. Plead the blood of Jesus over your going out and your coming in. Declare Psalm 100 and 21:7-8. "The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil. He shall preserve thy soul. The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time [music] forth and even forevermore." Then speak prophetically over your day. Declare that it will be a good day. Declare that favor will locate you. Declare that opportunities will present themselves. Declare that divine connections will be made. Declare that every evil plan against you is nullified. [music] Declare that you will walk in victory. Your words have creative power. Proverbs 18:21 says, >> [music] >> "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall [music] eat the fruit thereof." As I begin to close this ministration, I want to pray with you and make prophetic declarations over your life. I want you to agree with me in the spirit. I want you to receive these words [music] by faith. I want you to believe that what I'm declaring is not just wishful [music] thinking, but the word of the Lord that will come to pass in your life. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I lift up every person under the sound of my voice tonight, I pray that you will go before them in every area of their lives. Go before them [music] in their families. Go before them in their careers. Go before them in their [music] businesses. Go before them in their ministries. Go before them in their relationships. Prepare the way for them. Remove every [music] obstacle. Break every barrier. Open every closed door. I decree and declare that divine favor is released upon them right now in the name of Jesus. Favor that cannot be explained by human logic. Favor that [music] causes them to be celebrated where they were previously rejected. Favor that brings them to the attention of key decision makers. Favor that opens doors no man can shut. I prophesy that their days will be peaceful. Every spirit of chaos, I command you to leave their lives now in Jesus' name. Every spirit of confusion, I bind you and cast you out. Every spirit of anxiety, every spirit of fear, every spirit of worry, [music] I command you to lose your hold over their minds and their emotions. Peace of God settle upon them now. Let the peace that passes [music] all understanding guard their hearts and minds through Christ Jesus. I decree and declare [music] that they will walk in victory. Every battle they face, they will overcome. Every challenge they encounter, they will surmount. Every test they go through, they will pass. They will not be defeated. They will not be overcome. They will not be put to shame. They are more than conquerors through Christ who loves them. Father, I pray that you will station [music] your angels around them. Psalm 34:7 says, "The angel of the Lord encamped round about them that [music] fear him and delivered them." Let your angels surround them. Let your angels protect them. Let your angels fight for them. Let your [music] angels prepare the way before them. I command every evil altar speaking against their destiny to be destroyed by fire in the name [music] of Jesus. Every witchcraft operation, every occultic manipulation, [music] every satanic agenda are nullified by the power in the blood of Jesus. I decree that no weapon formed against them shall prosper. And every tongue that [music] rises against them in judgment, they shall condemn. I prophesy acceleration over their lives. What should have taken [music] years will happen in months. What should have taken months will happen in weeks. What should have taken weeks will happen in days. God is accelerating their timeline. He's hastening their breakthrough. He's expediting [music] their manifestation. Beloved, as I draw this ministration to a close, I want to encourage you to [music] take this word seriously. Don't just listen to it and forget about it. Don't just say amen and move on with your life as if nothing [music] has been said. This is a word that can transform your daily experience if you will apply it. This is [music] a word that can revolutionize the way you approach each day if you will believe it. Starting this morning, begin to pray [music] this prayer with faith and conviction. "Lord, go ahead of me and make my day peaceful and victorious." Don't just say it once, [music] say it with authority. Say it with expectation. Say it believing that God hears you and that he will honor his word. Remember that God is faithful. He cannot lie. He cannot fail. What he has promised, he is able also to perform. Romans 4:21 reminds us of Abraham's faith, "Being fully persuaded that what he had promised, he was able also to perform." [music] You must come to that place of being fully persuaded. You must come to that place of absolute confidence in God's ability and willingness to go before you. The Bible says in Deuteronomy 31:8, "And the Lord, he it is that doth go before thee. He will be with thee. He will not fail thee. Neither forsake thee. Fear not. Neither be dismayed." This is God's promise to you. He goes before you. He is with you. He will not fail you. He will not forsake you. Therefore, you have no reason to fear and no reason to be dismayed. As you step [music] into each new day, step with confidence. Step with boldness. Step with assurance. You are not walking alone. You are not facing your challenges by yourself. The Lord your God goes before you. He's your [music] forerunner. He's your advance guard. He's your divine strategist. He's your protector. He's your provider. He's your peace. He's your victory. And I declare over you today that from this moment forward, you will begin to see the evidence [music] of God going before you. You will begin to experience divine appointments that you know you did not orchestrate. You will begin to witness doors opening that you know [music] human effort could not have opened. You will begin to enjoy favor that you know you did not earn. This is because [music] God has gone ahead of you and prepared the way. May the Lord bless you and keep you. May the Lord make his face shine upon you and be gracious unto you. May the Lord lift up his countenance [music] upon you and give you peace. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I have spoken and so shall it be. Amen.
